subject: Band merging guidelines + appeals triage (Calibration run 2)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: eva@benchconsulting.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Band merging guidelines + appeals triage (Calibration run 2)

Hi all,

Following our calibration run last week there are two items we need to finalize before manager sign-off: the proposed band-merge hygiene (how we treat adjacent bands where distributions overlap) and a lightweight appeals triage so managers have a clear process and timing.

I attached: band_merge_matrix.xlsx (working matrix with recomputed counts), appeals_template.docx (manager-facing form), supporting_notes.pdf (rationale and examples). Please review the matrix and the triage flow by EOD Monday (4/12). Key asks: 
- Monica: confirm the conservative merge thresholds (I put a draft in column D).
- Rishi: can you run the post-merge headcount and delta by region (US/EU/APAC) and paste updated numbers into the matrix?
- Tessa: propose a 90-minute calibration slot that includes time for appeals triage and HR handoff.
- Laura: once we lock thresholds, please draft the short manager note (<= 3 bullets) we can send with the appeals form.

We have Bench Consulting (eva) in CC as a sanity check on the process; we only want their input if we diverge from the standard approach.

Why this path: last run showed inflation at band boundaries. Merging adjacent bands where the distribution is within +/-3 points reduces manual rework and manager appeals while preserving differentiation. The attached supporting_notes.pdf shows two anonymized examples.

If anyone thinks we should revert to the prior approach, say so — otherwise assume momentum to finalise this week.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, People Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments: band_merge_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 42KB), appeals_template.docx (Word, 18KB), supporting_notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Band merging guidelines + appeals triage (Calibration run 2)

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following our calibration run last week there are two items we need to finalize...

Thanks, Jas — looked through the matrix. Quick notes: 
- I agree with conservative thresholds in column D for US and EU; APAC sample size is small so we should require manager justification before merging there.
- Suggest tightening the delta threshold for "mid" bands from 3 to 2 points when headcount in-band is > 10 to avoid flattening high-density teams.

I'll annotate the sheet with inline comments. For appeals triage: prefer a two-track queue: 1) fast-track (insufficient evidence) — resolved within 3 business days by HR+manager; 2) full-review (disputed evidence) — schedule within 7 business days and include an escalation to an ex-manager reviewer. The appeals_template is good but add a one-line required field: "impact to role / business metric" so managers prioritize.

Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. People Partner

Attachment references: commented band_merge_matrix.xlsx

2) Wed 4/14 14:00-15:30 PT (wider managers invited, good for regional overlap)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Band merging guidelines + appeals triage (Calibration run 2)

Attached updated numbers in the matrix (column F / sheet "post_merge_summary"). Summary: 
- US: net +4 headcount moved to upper band after conservative merge (total headcount unchanged; distribution more compact).
- EU: net -1 in mid band, small uptick in lower; overall variance within expected CI.
- APAC: sample size too small — flagged rows for manager review.

I also ran a quick sensitivity for the tighter 2-point delta Monica suggested. For teams with >10 people, the 2-point rule avoids compressing top-performers and reduces manager appeals by ~12% in the model. I've added notes beside affected team rows.

Rishi
People Data Science

Attachment references: updated band_merge_matrix.xlsx (sheet: post_merge_summary)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Band merging guidelines + appeals triage (Calibration run 2)

Thanks everyone — good work. Quick decisions and next steps: 
- Thresholds: accept Monica's conservative thresholds for US/EU; for APAC require manager pre-approval (we'll call it an "APAC exception" in the manager note).
- For >10 headcount teams use the 2-point delta Monica suggested (Rishi's sensitivity supports this).
- Appeals triage: adopt the two-track approach; Tessa to operationalize the SLAs and HR assignments.
- Communications: Laura, please draft the manager note and the short FAQ to accompany appeals_template.docx; aim to send manager comms Thu 4/15.

I'll run the final sign-off thread on Thu morning after we get Laura's note. If no objections by Thu 11:59am PT, we proceed to sign-off and open the appeals window.

Jasmine

P.S. Eva — appreciate the quick review last week. We'll loop you only if we need an external validation call.
